title: Choose Stargaze's new visual world
question: The roll assigned Cosmic Cinema Title Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Cosmic Cinema Title Card
options.lineage: 1960s–80s sci-fi title sequences and Criterion film stills
options.thesis: Today's APOD is the opening title still — letterboxed, monumental, with credits typography beneath.
options.viewport: Full viewport letterboxed APOD still with gold date stamp and film-credit title stack; two brass ticket actions for Gallery and News.
options.risk: Reads cinematic-generic if the photography doesn't dominate and the chrome stays quiet.

raised.raise: The still sits inside a warm auditorium glow at the edges, not a cold tech void.
The gallery browses as a perforated film strip that snaps frame-to-frame by date.

options.label: Darkroom Contact Sheet
options.lineage: Astronomer's proof sheets and grease-pencil selects
options.thesis: Today's APOD is the circled proof on a contact sheet; the archive is the rest of the roll.
options.viewport: Horizontal contact sheet with today's frame circled in red pencil; darkroom lamp warmth at the margins.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on — photography portals often default to darkroom metaphors.

options.label: Wax Pack Card Stack
options.thesis: Each APOD is a collectible card — portrait front, explanation on the stat back; gallery deals the stack.
options.viewport: Today's card dealt face-up with team border; flip reveals explanation stats; wax seal on archive entry.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: each day is a collectible; holds identification for casual browsers, loses on gravitas for the hero image.
options.risk: Playful tone can undercut the awe of deep-space photography.

options.label: Film Cutting Bench
options.thesis: APOD dates string along a perforated select rail; today's frame is flagged with orange tape.
options.viewport: Horizontal film strip rail across the viewport with today's frame flagged; hung trims below for news.
options.case: Fuses well for chronological browsing; holds product clarity for the archive, loses on warmth for first-time wonder.
options.risk: Brutalist orange-on-black can feel editorial-cold without the photography breaking through.

options.label: Akari Light Sculpture
options.case: Fuses poorly: the lantern form competes with the photograph for attention.
options.kept: Warm interior glow that makes the image feel exhibited, not uploaded.

options.label: Data Sublime Field
options.case: Fuses poorly: pure data aesthetic erases the emotional pull of NASA photography.
options.kept: Ruthless typographic discipline and zero decorative chrome.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark photography portal — full-bleed hero, card grid, minimal nav. Executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Today's image hero left, headline right, gallery cards below — the arrangement visitors expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other space imagery app.
